# WearTAK Plugin SDK

The SDK AARs in `app/libs/` are built from the clean canonical SDK checkout at
`86bdc8b04797c2cf6caa30e78e796abac1c2a330`:

https://git.tak.gov/weartak-plugins/weartak-plugin-sdk

The SDK is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later. Preserve `LICENSE` and
`LICENSE-ADDITIONAL-PERMISSION.md` with SDK-derived binaries. No SDK signing key or private
credential is included.
